title: Natural Gas
headline_read: Natural gas costs are stable or easing.

indicators.title: Henry Hub Spot Price
indicators.context: The U.S. benchmark natural-gas price ($/MMBtu) — it drives home heating bills and a large share of electricity generation cost.
indicators.read: Natural gas costs have fallen 20% over the past year — relief for households.

indicators.title: Working Gas in Storage · Lower 48
indicators.context: Working natural gas held in underground storage (Bcf) — the cushion that buffers winter demand; low storage means price risk.
indicators.read: Gas in storage is little changed from a year ago, now 3,056.
indicators.no_severity_reason: A physical supply-and-demand reading, not a household cost — this lens's verdict comes from the price indicators.

indicators.title: U.S. Dry Gas Production
indicators.context: U.S. dry natural-gas production — record output has reshaped both home energy costs and the country's role as an exporter.
indicators.read: Dry gas production is up 4% from a year ago, now 3,327,661.
indicators.no_severity_reason: A physical supply-and-demand reading, not a household cost — this lens's verdict comes from the price indicators.

indicators.title: U.S. LNG Exports
indicators.context: U.S. liquefied natural gas exports — a fast-growing link between domestic gas prices and global demand.
indicators.read: LNG exports is up 20% from a year ago, now 537,936.
indicators.no_severity_reason: A physical supply-and-demand reading, not a household cost — this lens's verdict comes from the price indicators.
